guarantees.claim: aes_ctrl_e enumeration defines fixed symbolic values: CTRL_IDLE=6'b001001, CTRL_LOAD=6'b100011, CTRL_PRNG_UPDATE=6'b111101, CTRL_PRNG_RESEED=6'b010000, CTRL_FINISH=6'b100100, CTRL_CLEAR_I=6'b111010, CTRL_CLEAR_CO=6'b001110, CTRL_ERROR=6'b010111.

uncertain_points.claim: Enumeration encodings appear deliberately non-consecutive and sparse (e.g., CTRL_IDLE=6'b001001, CTRL_ERROR=6'b010111), but no comment explains the encoding policy.
uncertain_points.risk: Without design intent, future maintenance or verification may misinterpret the Hamming/spacing requirements, potentially weakening fault resistance.

uncertain_points.claim: Only 8 of the 64 possible 6-bit states are defined; the finite state machine using this enum must handle the remaining 56 values to prevent illegal state entry or undefined control flow.
uncertain_points.cond: when an aes_ctrl_e signal assumes an undefined value due to cosmic upset, reset glitch, or logic error
uncertain_points.risk: Undefined state can cause deadlock, secret leakage, or bypass of clear/error processing if not caught by a default case or checker.
